about_the_game:
◆ An Epic Three Kingdoms Adventure Penned by You ◆

The flames of war rage, and heroes rise from all corners. You, a promising warrior, step resolutely into this tumultuous era of the Three Kingdoms. Your story is not a mere footnote in history books, but a brand-new legend woven from countless quests, battles, and choices.

◆ Quest-Driven, Explore a Vast World ◆

Take on commissions from townfolk, gather intelligence on enemy forces, challenge formidable warlords dominating the regions... Your adventure is propelled by a series of thrilling quests. Each journey will lead you to new maps with distinct styles: from bustling Central Plains towns to grim frontier fortresses, and further into mysterious deep mountain caves. Unknown challenges and rewards always await ahead.

◆ Focused Progression, Master Flashy Martial Arts ◆

This title ditches complex gear systems, allowing you to focus entirely on the core action experience.
Earn rewards through combat and seek out masters to learn new active skills and passive talents. From swift spear techniques to overwhelming area-of-effect cleaves, from agile dodges to empowering auras—forge your unique combat style. Skillfully combine your abilities to unleash stunning combos on the battlefield!

◆ Fluid Combat, Low-Spec Friendly ◆

We are committed to delivering the purest action-adventure fun. Thus, the game is built on an optimized engine—no top-tier graphics card needed, it runs smoothly even on entry-level PCs!Whether on a hefty gaming laptop or a lightweight office computer, you can be immersed in this Three Kingdoms world anytime, anywhere.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Sierra (10.12) ( or higher)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2.0 GHz or higher)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Pro 5200, Intel Iris 5100, Intel HD 5000 (or better or higher)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: null

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 / 11 (64-bit required or higher)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2130 or AMD FX-4300 (or equivalent or higher)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible card with 1 GB VRAM (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GT 730 or AMD Radeon R7 240 or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: null

short_description: Become a Three Kingdoms hero and embark on an action-packed adventure! In this top-down ARPG, take on quests, master powerful skills, and explore new lands. Grow through intense combat and carve your own legend. No loot, just pure skill-based gameplay. So lightweight, it runs on any computer!
